title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0111e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.052589
  m_eff = 2.3582e-1 eV
  T_vev = 3.1006e-1 m⁻²
  ω = 0.1018 s⁻¹
  k = 0.0100 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.098160 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -7.062e-1
  J_spin = -1.452e-1
